target.title: fix(ai): keep OpenAI tool call id truncation UTF-16 safe
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`normalizeToolCallId` in `openai-completions.ts:1052` truncates oversized OpenAI tool call IDs with `id.slice(0, 40)`. When a tool call ID contains a UTF-16 surrogate pair straddling positions 39-40, `slice` splits the pair and leaves an unpaired high surrogate — producing **invalid Unicode in the outbound API request**.

## Why This Change Was Made

`String.prototype.slice(0, 40)` operates on UTF-16 code units. A surrogate pair (e.g. 🐱 `\uD83D\uDC31`) consumes 2 code units. The fix switches to `truncateUtf16Safe(id, 40)` from `@openclaw/normalization-core/utf16-slice`, an existing repo helper used by sibling UTF-16 PRs (#104054, #107664, #109561, #109498, #109839).

Sibling surfaces (non-OpenAI provider paths, other `normalizeToolCallId` branches) are unaffected — the change is scoped to the `model.provider === "openai"` check at line 1053.

Collision check: searched open PRs for `normalizeToolCallId`, `truncateUtf16Safe`, `tool_call_id`, `surrogate pair`; no same-file or same-problem open PR was found.

## User Impact

- Multi-model `openai` provider tool-call conversations produce valid Unicode in all IDs
- No change for IDs without surrogate pairs at the 40-unit boundary
- Non-OpenAI provider paths unchanged

## Evidence

Exact head: `fe95d101e2474aec8991f4355697691fb7d61e60`

`oxfmt --check packages/ai/src/providers/openai-completions.ts packages/ai/src/providers/openai-completions.test.ts` — passed.
`git diff --check` — passed; exit 0.

### Standalone proof (15 assertions, all boundary cases)

```
$ node --import tsx proof-openai-tool-call-id-utf16.mts

  info: input_id="xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx🐱"
  info: input_length=41
  ok: normalized id has no trailing high surrogate
  ok: normalized id <= 40 code units
  ok: ASCII prefix preserved
  ok: normalized id is valid JSON-encodable
  info: safe_id="xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx"
  info: safe_length=39
  ok: old .slice(0,40) leaves trailing high surrogate
  info: old_id="xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx\ud83d"
  info: old_length=40 trailing_surrogate=true
  info: input_id_length=42
  ok: case2: no trailing surrogate
  ok: case2: <= 40 code units
  ok: case2: old .slice(0,40) produces clean output when pair is past boundary
  ok: short id passthrough
  ok: exactly 40 id passthrough
  ok: cjk: no trailing surrogate
  ok: cjk: <= 40 code units
  info: cjk_safe="xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx中" length=40
  ok: music: no trailing high surrogate
  ok: music: <= 40 code units
  ok: music: old .slice(0,40) leaves trailing high surrogate

=== Summary ===
ALL PROOF ASSERTIONS: 15 passed, 0 failed
```

Covers 5 boundary cases: 🐱 at 39-40 (exact production boundary), 🐱 at 40-41 (pair beyond boundary), short/exactly-40 ID passthrough, CJK (BMP) at boundary, music emoji 𝄞 at boundary. Each case validates the fix against the old `.slice(0, 40)` behavior.

### Vitest suite

```
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs packages/ai/src/providers/openai-completions.test.ts

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  47 passed (47)
```

Test "truncates an oversized tool call id without cutting a surrogate pair":
- Input: 41-code-unit tool call ID with 🐱 surrogate pair at positions 39-40
- Normalized ID arrives at `client.chat.completions.create` via `mockOpenAIOptionsRef.payloads`
- `stopReason === "stop"` — stream completes naturally (no onPayload throw)
- Verified normalized `tool_call_id` in API payload: 39 code units, clean ASCII (surrogate pair dropped safely)

### Mutation check

Revert `truncateUtf16Safe(id, 40)` → `id.slice(0, 40)` in `openai-completions.ts:1053`:

```
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs packages/ai/src/providers/openai-completions.test.ts -t "truncates an oversized"

 FAIL  ... > truncates an oversized tool call id without cutting a surrogate pair
AssertionError: expected true to be false // Object.is equality
- Expected: false
+ Received: true
 ❯ .../openai-completions.test.ts:1700:51
     expect(/[\uD800-\uDBFF]$/.test(normalizedId)).toBe(false);

 Tests  1 failed | 46 skipped (47)
```

Restore `truncateUtf16Safe(id, 40)` → 47/47 passed.

### Not tested

- Live OpenAI API roundtrip with real API key
- Non-OpenAI provider tool call ID truncation paths (unchanged)
- Tool call IDs with multi-codepoint grapheme clusters at the boundary
